description.p: lsqnonlin solves nonlinear least-squares problems min sum(fun(x).^2), optionally subject to bounds and constraints.

The Algorithm option selects the engine: 'trust-region-reflective' (default), 'levenberg-marquardt' (also accepts bounds) or 'interior-point'. Linear or nonlinear constraints automatically use the interior-point algorithm.

The default MaxFunctionEvaluations is 100*numberOfVariables, MaxIterations is 400 and FunctionTolerance and StepTolerance are 1e-6. The Display option supports 'off', 'none', 'final', 'final-detailed', 'notify', 'notify-detailed', 'iter' and 'iter-detailed'.
If Jacobian is 'on' or SpecifyObjectiveGradient is true, fun must also return the Jacobian of the residuals.

xmldoc.bibliography: K. Levenberg, "A method for the solution of certain non-linear problems in least squares", Quarterly of Applied Mathematics, 1944. D. W. Marquardt, "An algorithm for least-squares estimation of nonlinear parameters", SIAM Journal on Applied Mathematics, 1963.
